newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France makes no net drain or injection.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France makes no net drain or injection.

text.p: The Bank of France made no net drain or injection at a same-day securities repurchase tender held on Friday to allocate funds for injection into the money market.
It accepted bids for 38.1 billion francs in new liquidity, the same amount as leaving the market on Friday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on May 9.
The Bank of France said earlier on Friday the interest rate used at the tender, the intervention rate, would be unchanged at 3.10 percent.
The Bank of France said it allocated 11.6 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 4.2 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 26.5 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 10.8 percent of this demand.
